name: Eigent
description: Desktop cowork app that runs a team of agents to automate multi-step workflows, locally or connected to the Eigent cloud.
whatItDoes: Lets a user build and manage a workforce of agents that split a complex task and execute parts in parallel, or run a single meta agent for focused jobs. Targets knowledge workers who want automation with local deployment and their own models.
howItWorks: A desktop front end talks to a backend built on the CAMEL framework's multi-agent workforce. Agents use built-in browser and terminal toolkits, skills and MCP integrations, with a fully local backend option that supports local model servers such as vLLM, Ollama and LM Studio.

requirements.name: Node.js 18-22 and npm
requirements.description: Needed for the cloud-connected quick start from source

requirements.name: LLM provider or local model server
requirements.description: Any supported model, including local vLLM, Ollama or LM Studio
